fills.name: Northern Migration (detail)
fills.quote: 村民 工人 50 [food icon] 22 秒
fills.note: Interval taken as the villager train time shown on the Town Center tooltip (22s); the auto-recruit interval itself is not stated on screen
fills.tieReason: Frames s_00026 to s_00029 show the same screen: the Northern Migration (北方迁移) card ('Town Center automatically recruits villagers for free until the villager cap; each Longhouse raises the cap by +10') next to the Viking Villager (村民) production tooltip showing 50 food and a 22 秒 (22s) clock. The narrator's subtitles say villagers cost no food, saving 150 resources per minute (3 villagers at 50 food each), and that the villager build time is 'only 2 seconds longer' (normal 20s, so 22s). The 22s is therefore the time between free villagers from the Town Center, which is the interval. This is inferred from the tooltip plus narration; the Northern Migration card itself does not print the number.
